text_block_list.text:
—The Tenno Sho (Spring). As expected, 
Symboli Kris S's name was nowhere to be 
found on the entry sheet.

There is nothing to fear. There shouldn't 
be anything, and yet—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's right, I have the talent of a 
stayer. And as for "resolve"... I have a 
bit of that too...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Top Road-chan told me that too! But...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Is there? Is there really~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm starting to get this feeling like... 
"There's no way that's true, right...?"
choice_data_list: There is! I swear there is!
There is! I swear there is!

text_block_list.text:
Desperately making a sliding catch on my 
dipping spirits. That's right—

If you don't keep encouraging Hishi 
Miracle's average-girl mindset, she 
gradually slumps. That hasn't changed, 
even now.
choice_data_list: And Symboli Kris S isn't even here today!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Well, that is... certainly true.
choice_data_list: I kind of feel like it'll work out, too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Just a gut feeling! That's really 
important, right!"
choice_data_list: You can do it, you'll definitely win!
You can do it, you'll definitely win!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I'm starting to feel that way too! At 
this distance, even if my engine starts up 
slow, I can still make it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'll do it, here I go! I'm a girl who can 
get things done!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle! Here comes Hishi Miracle! 
Now, how far will she go to meet their 
expectations?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Expectations? Come to think of it, what 
popularity rank am I today, I wonder...?)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: (1st? 2nd? Or maybe around 7th?)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Well, whatever. Doesn't matter what 
favorite I am. Because...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(That's right... when the Kikuka Sho 
ended, that was the moment... I made my 
decision.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: What I'm...! Aiming for isssss!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"The Tenno Sho (Spring)~~~~!!!!!! I'm 
gonna wiiiiiiin there!!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
With Trainer pushing me forward, I decided 
for myself. That I will "win." That's why—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't matter what favorite I am! 1st 
place matters way more than being 1st 
favorite!!
